requirement:
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.authoring.invocation`. The cited `requirements.authoring.refresh` is also exercised in the subject's own case. I found no gaps.

- **Single-subject command for a requirement or an example.**
  - `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[initial_prompt_substitutes_subject_and_mandatory_inputs_into_the_template]` runs `habeas author` once with a requirement and once with a named example. It checks the evidence record has the right field (`requirement` or `example`) and the other field is absent.
  - `fn[author_rejects_unknown_subjects_and_conflicting_targets]` shows an unknown subject fails and names it in stderr. It also shows `<subject>` with `--all` is rejected and leaves the existing evidence unchanged.
- **Completion report.**
  - `fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]` and the initial-prompt test assert stdout starts with `<subject>: ollama / <MODEL>`. That covers subject, backend and model.
  - They also assert an `Evidence:` line whose path resolves to `evidence/<subject>.json`, and a `Usage:` line pointing at an existing file.
- **Evidence destination in `--stdout` mode.**
  - `fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` asserts stderr contains `Evidence: stdout`, the `<subject>: ollama / <MODEL>` line and a `Usage:` path to a file that exists.
  - It parses stdout as pure evidence JSON, so no report text reaches stdout. It also checks project files are unchanged, with and without an existing evidence directory, and with and without `-v`.
  - Failure diagnostics in stdout mode also go to stderr. An unmarked test, `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[an_untracked_mandatory_input_is_reported_with_how_to_stage_it]`, asserts the stderr text and a failing exit. The marked tests are enough for this obligation.
- **`--config`.** `fn[an_explicit_configuration_selects_the_nondefault_workspace_profile]` selects a non-default profile and checks the request model, key, and usage backend and model come from it. `fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]` covers the default selection.
- **`-v`/`--verbose`.** `fn[verbose_single_author_reports_only_false_rationale_without_source_inputs]` covers `-v` and `--verbose` with true and false determinations. `fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` also covers verbose in stdout mode.
- **`author-evidence` alias.** The alias is used in the ollama CLI test, the stdout test and the batch refresh test. It runs the full flow and the skipped-as-current path.
- **Refresh behaviour.** `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[missing_keeps_current_records_and_force_reassesses_every_selected_subject]` checks all of these:
  - `--missing` is the default, with and without the flag, and no model is invoked. It succeeds with a broken config file, and the skipped-as-current count is reported.
  - `--missing` with `--force` fails with "cannot be used with", as does `--stdout` with `--missing`.
  - `--force` reassesses, and `--stdout` implies `--force`.
  - An invalid evidence file is reassessed under `--missing`.

text: :::{req} invocation
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
:::{req} refresh
Every `habeas author` form MUST accept `--missing` and `--force`, which are
mutually exclusive; `--missing` MUST be the default. Under `--missing`, the
command MUST assess only the selected subjects whose evidence is missing, stale,
or invalid, and MUST preserve every current record without invoking a model,
including accepted FIXME judgments and current false judgments; a current false
judgment is reassessed only when its subject or inputs change or `--force` is
given. Under `--force`, the command MUST assess every selected subject. `--stdout`
MUST imply `--force`, because it writes no evidence. The command MUST report the
number of selected subjects it skipped as current. When no assessment is needed,
the command MUST succeed without resolving model configuration or credentials.
